instances.docstring: Produce a weighted count: two points topping the upper mark, one exceeding the lower.
Produce a weighted count: two points beyond the upper mark, one surpassing the lower.
Accumulate a figure: two points past the upper mark, one clearing the lower.
Yield a list with values held inside the floor and ceiling, in between unchanged.
Yield a list with values held inside the floor and ceiling, when mid-range unchanged.
Assemble a list with values bounded within the floor and ceiling, otherwise unchanged.
Report the balance: numbers beating the ceiling, offset by those short of the floor.
Report the balance: numbers passing the ceiling, balanced by those slipping past the floor.
Derive the net count: numbers passing the ceiling, against those beneath the floor.
Rank ordered couples as equal, larger, or smaller, or a guard code if blank.
Score ordered two-tuples as equal, larger, or smaller, or a reserve code if unfilled.
Weigh ordered duos as equal, larger, or smaller, or a fallback code if vacant.
Compose a list of upper numbers weighted, with zeros for below-baseline ones.
Produce a list of qualifying numbers amplified, with zeros for deficient ones.
Compose a list of large numbers boosted, with zeros for minus ones.
Give the greatest value plus its tie count, or a guard code if blank.
Report the maximum value plus its match count, or a reserve code if unfilled.
Produce the largest value plus its recurrences, or a fallback code if blank.
Measure the extent of the largest and smallest values, or a default code if unfilled.
Report the gap of the largest and smallest values, or a guard code if vacant.
Produce the spread of the largest and smallest values, or a reserve code if empty.
Compute ordered couples where an addition exceeds the cap or a spread sinks below the margin.
Compute ordered combinations where an addition beats the cap or a gap slips below the margin.
Accumulate ordered duos where a sum clears the cap or a gap drops below the margin.
Total, per number past the threshold, how many later entries fall short of or equal it.
Report, per number clearing the mark, how many later entries undercut or mirror it.
Compute, per number beyond the bar, how many later entries trail or tie with it.
Return an aggregate that stops at the first drop, limits high values, counts the rest.
Build a sum that terminates at the first minus value, trims outsized values, keeps the rest.
Return a tally that terminates at the first minus value, caps outsized values, takes the rest.
Find the tally of numbers inside the lower and upper bounds.
Give a count of numbers spanning the lower and upper bounds.
Find the quantity of numbers amid the lower and upper bounds.
Give the earliest match index, an abort marker above the bound, or a sentinel code.
Find the soonest match index, a cutoff marker over-limit, or a reserve code.
Locate the leading match index, a bail-out marker above the bound, or a fallback code.
Accumulate a tally that boosts large numbers and reduces low ones.
Accumulate a score that weights top numbers and discounts low ones.
Accumulate a total that weights high numbers and trims under-floor ones.
Produce a weighted sum rewarding three known keys individually and discarding the rest.
Tally a weighted sum weighting three known keys uniquely and passing over the rest.
Return a weighted sum weighting three known keys distinctly and ignoring the rest.
Assemble a list doubling halvable entries and overwriting high odd ones for a set figure.
Assemble a list boosting two-fold entries and exchanging large odd ones for a preset.
Map to a list multiplying even entries and overwriting large odd ones for a fixed value.
